data.body: DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED. (a) Wave-1 manifest gap: w3_rebar_run.load_run and w3_file_impact.derive searched only runs_wave3.json, so wave-1 run ids raised 'unknown run_id' / IndexError before rebar was invoked. Two 2948-48e5-BLOCK draws had been recorded void by it; they were reclassified as instrument failures (nothing ran, nothing billed, nothing written) and both have since been collected. (b) Three grammars narrower than the writer, all now accepting one optional trailing variant letter: campaign.rebar_disk_draws, extract.split_rebar_artifact, and the generic per-arm cost enumeration in independence(). (c) census reconstructed rebar tags as f'rep{n}', discarding the variant letter, so a re-run credited at rep2d was looked up as rep2, matched the original void and left two fully paid verdicts uncredited; it now reads the tag from the filename. (d) adjudicate.py never compared ballot_sha256 -- proven by adjudicating against a deliberately different ballot (exit 0, identical counts, wrong hash stamped). (e) 6120-acda-BLOCK's published adjudication was computed against a ballot none of its three judges read (judges declare 7b743529..., disk holds df08e429...); the ballot they voted on is not on disk. The new gate passes 39 of 40 and refuses exactly that one.
